content: Xillotithii benttizay ammanora
Yinttano, akaaka baa Galaatiya asitayyo, yi aafay tiinayid Kiristtoosa mazqqalel afa sotintteez garkk misilinttii pidhdhe benttiza. Yeezin, tumas yi kiitinttaamay garkk yinttan biteezay oonoo?
Pettii baz erodayis ta koyiza; yi Geeshsha Ayyana ekkeezay higge naagorannee woy yi si7eez Wonggila ammanora?
Yi yhay garkk boozoo? Yi Xoossa Ayyanar aykkii, yhatti ashor polodayis koyinee?
Yi Wonggile baggar gaame daabureezay ceree? Ye meto ubbay cere maaqqaree?
Xoossay yinttis Geeshsha Ayyana inggizaynnee yi gancce malla baz oothizay, yi higge naageezay gishonnee? Wonggile si7ii ammaneez gishoso?
An Afraamena bo7oytta, «E Xoossana ammaneeza; Xoossay ezis yeya xillotithi mahii tayibeeza» yeeginttii xaafintteeza.
Yikkee, ammanizitay Afraame na7ita maaqqizana eroytta.
Xoossay Ayihude baa as ammanor xillithodana Geeshsha Maxaafay tiina bi7ii, «Woya ubbay ne baggar anjjinttoda» yeegii, Mishiraachcho Qaala Afraames tiinattii odeeza.
Yey gishos, ammaniza ubbay ammaneez Afraamer wolla anjjintteeza.
Higge naagii xillod giz oonkka cazhintteeza. Abis giiko, Geeshsha Maxaafayid, «Higge maxaafay gancce xaafintteez ubba naagoowa oonkka cazhintteeza maaqqo» ginttinttii xaafintteeza.
«Xillo as ammanor yezoda» ginttinttii xaafintteez gishos oonkka Xooss tiina higge naagii xilloozay erintteez bazi.
Higge ammanor wolla yhanigooya. Zin, «Higge higger yezodayis danda7izay higge azazo ubba poliko» yeegeeza.
«Mithal afa sotinttii yhayqqiz oonkka cazhintteeza» ginttinttii xaafintteez gishos Kiristtoosa nu gishos cazhintteeza maaqqii, nuna higge cashshapp wozeeza.
Xoossay Afraames inggeez anjjo, Yesuus Kiristtoosa baggar Ayihude baa as hellodgarkkennee Xoossay immad geez Geeshsha Ayyana nuunii ammanor ekkodgarkk yeya ootheeza.
Higgennee ufayis qaala
Ta ishuntho, ta yinttis as yessar gami7i yeza baz aaziso udii odiza. Asii caaqqeez caaqo qaalay minggeezaypp guye, oonkka ye caaqo qaala shaarodayis woy ezal afa hara gujjodayis danda7ooya.

Xoossay ye ufayis qaala Afraamesinnee e sheeshayis inggeeza. Geeshsha Maxaafay, gaame asis odizaygarkk, «Ne sheeshitayis» gooya. Zin pettii asis odizay garkk, «Ne sheeshayis» yeegiza; ezkka Kiristtoosa.
Taanii gizay yhaya; oyddii xeetannee hasttam laythapp guye inggintteez higgay, tiina Xoossay mintheez caaqo qaala shaarii ufayssi qaala dhabisodayis danda7ooya.
Xoossay inggiz laatay higger ekinttizabaz maaqqeezako Xoossay inggeez ufayssay baggar maaqqizay attiza. Zin Xoossay fa aadho keehatithar laata Afraames ufayss qaala baggar inggeeza.
Higge abis inggintteezako

Yeezin, higgay abis ingginttenee? Higge inggntteezay, Afraames ufayss qaala inggintteez zerithay ye7od gatho iita ooso abizako ersodayssii. Higge kiitanchchitay baggar ingginttii, gancce maaqqii dabbothiza pettii as baggar oosol afa peezheeza.
Gancce maaqqii dabbothiza athay pettii bagga aaddapp baaya, zin Xoossay petto.
Yeezin, higgay Xooss ufayssi qaala ixxinennee? Ixxooya! Higge inggintteezay de7o immadayis maaqqeezako, xillotithii higge baggar benttodazin.
Zin Yesuus Kiristtoosa ammanin benttiz ufayssi qaalay ammanizitayis ingginttod garkk alamay kunthay nagara achcha yezana Geeshsha Maxaafay odiza.
Zin ammano ye7odaypp tiina higge nuna accii gaddeeza. Ye ammanay benttod gatho higgay nuul afa gorddii gaddeeza.
Yey gishos, nuunii ammanor xillod garkk Kiristtoosa ye7od gatho higgay na7a naagiz as garkk nuna naagiza maaqqeeza.
Zin yhatte ammano ye7eez gishos higge yhaypp guye na7a naagiz as garkk maaqqeez higgay oommor aqith atteeza.
Yi ubbitay Yesuus Kiristtoosana ammanii Xooss na7ita maaqqeeza.
Kiristtoosar petto maaqqodayis xammaqqintteez ubbitay Kiristtoosana afila garkk ma7eeza.
Yi ubbitay Kiristtoosar petto maaqqeez gishos Ayihude as ganccennee Girike as gancce, aylle ganccennee womaanno gancce, dhiirathi ganccennee maachchi gancce dummatithii baaya.
Yikkee, yi Kiristtoosas maaqqiko yi Afraame kochchii. Xooss ufayis qaalay garkk yi laattizita.
